thread:
jordan_acme: Hey team — we just hit duplicate side effects from a tool call. Customer charged twice. Request id: req_20260317_9a7f. Happened ~10:02 UTC. Can you help?

sophia: Sorry about that — can you paste the request payload + any SDK version and whether you saw any 5xx/timeout from our API?

jordan_acme: Payload below (redacted). SDK: node 2.8.1. We see 202 then later a success. Seems like SDK retried.
```json
{
  "model": "redwood-chat-1",
  "input": "charge customer 12345",
  "tool_call": {
    "name": "charge-customer",
    "arguments": "{\"amount\":100,\"currency\":\"USD\"}"
  },
  "client_request_id": "req_20260317_9a7f"
}
```

max: ah that arguments field is a string not an object. SDK should have serialized, but older SDKs sometimes double-encode. If our tool harness rejects schema, behavior depends on how the runtime surfaced the error to the SDK.

eli: pulling logs for req_20260317_9a7f now. infra-bot: correlate logs.

infra-bot: Correlated logs: alpha /runtime/gateway -> 2026-03-17T10:02:15Z request=req_20260317_9a7f client_ip=52.15.2.33
runtime: toolcall.start name=charge-customer request=req_20260317_9a7f
runtime: toolcall.validate FAILED reason=arguments_not_object
runtime: respond_to_client status=400 body="tool validation error" request=req_20260317_9a7f
proxy: returned 202 to client (gateway timeout to runtime) request=req_20260317_9a7f
worker: later tool execution completed success request=exec_7b2a (note: exec_7b2a has same client_request_id)

eli: summary: gateway race. Runtime validation returned 400 quickly, but between gateway and client there was a transient timeout that caused the SDK to treat it as a retriable failure (SDK saw no definitive 4xx). Client retried the whole HTTP request; on the second attempt the runtime accepted/processed (or the background worker finished), so tool executed twice.

sophia: that matches the customer's timeline — first they saw a 202 (we returned early), then a success and charge. They retried once automatically. They were on SDK 2.8.1 which had a retry-on-unknown behavior for 202/no-body.

max: actionable items: 1) refund/dedup for this customer (support ops). 2) short-term: add server-side dedupe by client_request_id for tool executions (idempotency). 3) medium-term: make gateway surface validation errors as clear 4xx consistently (avoid returning 202). 4) call out SDK patch to stop retrying on 202-without-body or to include idempotency header.

eli: for reproduction steps I ran this locally:
```bash
# reproduce double-exec locally with patched payload
curl -v -H "Authorization: Bearer REDACT" -d @payload.json 
  https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate && sleep 1 && curl -v -H "Authorization: Bearer REDACT" -d @payload.json https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate
# where payload.json has the arguments as a quoted string to emulate client bug
```

max: adding runtime log snippet to ticket:
"toolcall.validate FAILED: arguments type=string expected=object; gateway returned 202 due to worker queue backpressure; client retried -> duplicate execution"

sophia: I've opened SUP-4321 and flagged for refund. Notifying billing for reversal. Also pinging SDK team to release 2.8.2 with idempotency header support.

jordan_acme: Thanks. Two asks: 1) will we get a full timeline + whether this will recur? 2) can you confirm refund ETA?

eli: timeline: root cause = double-encoding of tool arguments by client SDK + gateway's transient behavior returning 202 in the validation window. Fixes prioritized: immediate dedupe guard (48h hotfix), gateway change to return validation 4xx (72h), SDK patch (next release).

max: check list for hotfix (assigned): runtime team to reject and persist validation failures with status=400; add pre-exec idempotency check on client_request_id; add metric to alert if same client_request_id observed >1 within 5m.

sophia: refund queued, billing ACKed, ETA EOD today for reversal. I've told jordan_acme to hold off any manual retries.

jordan_acme: appreciate it. please also send the minimal repro so we can patch our SDK usage.

eli: pasted repro in ticket SUP-4321 + adding code sample to SDK PR.

max: leaving this open until hotfix is deployed. Will post updates in thread. :white_check_mark:
